requirements.quote: The Version field of long headers is 0x6b3343cf.
requirements.condition: when encoding or processing a QUIC version 2 long header
requirements.required_behavior: set or recognize the Version field as 0x6b3343cf
requirements.forbidden_behavior: use a different Version field value for a QUIC version 2 long header
requirements.why_checkable: The four-byte Version field in an encoded long header can be compared directly with 0x6b3343cf.
